name: 体感温度（温湿风效应）计算

map.输入气温、相对湿度、风速，自动计算酷热指数、风寒指数与表观温度，并根据温度区间给: Enter the air temperature, relative humidity and wind speed to automatically compute the heat index, wind chill index and apparent temperature, and select the primary reference value by temperature range
map.📖 查看「体感温度（温湿风效应）计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Apparent Temperature (Temperature-Humidity-Wind Effect) Calculation User Guide"
map.湿热风体感综合三种经验模型：高温(T≥27℃)用酷热指数 HI=heatInde: The temperature-humidity-wind apparent temperature integrates three empirical models: for high temperature (T≥27°C) the heat index HI=heatIndexC(T,RH), for low temperature (T≤10°C) the wind chill index WC=windChillC(T,Vkmh), and for the middle range the apparent temperature AT=apparentTempC(T,RH,Vms); all three convert temperature, humidity and wind speed into an apparent temperature via empirical formulas, with wind speed converted as Vkmh=V×3.6 and Vms=V÷3.6.
map.💡 高温高湿看酷热指数（HI），低温多风看风寒指数（WC），其余以表观温度（AT: 💡 For high temperature and humidity use the heat index (HI), for low temperature and wind use the wind chill index (WC), and otherwise use the apparent temperature (AT). Wind chill is only valid when the wind speed is ≥ 4.8 km/h.
map.快速计算，结果可一键复制: quick calculation; the result can be copied in one click
map.酷热指数（Rothfusz 回归）适用于气温 ≥ 27℃ 的高温高湿环境: The heat index (Rothfusz regression) applies to high-temperature, high-humidity environments with air temperature ≥ 27°C
map.风寒指数（TWC/NWS 公式）适用于气温 ≤ 10℃ 且风速 ≥ 4.8 km: The wind chill index (TWC/NWS formula) applies to air temperature ≤ 10°C with wind speed ≥ 4.8 km/h
map.表观温度（AT，Steadman）综合温度、湿度、风速，适用范围最广: The apparent temperature (AT, Steadman) combines temperature, humidity and wind speed and has the widest applicability
map.📚 深度解析：温度换算与体感: 📚 In-depth: Temperature Conversion and Apparent Temperature
map.由基础气温结合风/湿算体感。: Compute the apparent temperature from the base air temperature with wind/humidity.
map.37°C=98.6°F=310.15 K；−40°C=−40°F（唯一相等点），: 37°C=98.6°F=310.15 K; −40°C=−40°F (the only equal point); unify units in cross-unit reports to avoid misreading.
map.基础 0°C 配风速 15 m/s → 风寒体感≈−12°C，提示保暖而非只看气: Base 0°C with a wind speed of 15 m/s → wind chill ≈−12°C, a reminder to keep warm rather than just looking at the air temperature.
map.K 和 °C 差多少？: How much do K and °C differ?
map.K=°C+273.15，差一个常数，用于热力学公式必须转 K。: K=°C+273.15, a constant offset; thermodynamic formulas require conversion to K.
map.体感比气温低正常吗？: Is it normal for the apparent temperature to be lower than the air temperature?
map.有风（风寒）或湿冷蒸发时会低于实温；湿热高湿时相反的炎热指数会高于实温。: With wind (wind chill) or damp-cold evaporation it is lower than the actual temperature; conversely, in hot humid conditions the heat index is higher.
map.体感温度计算器综合气温、相对湿度与风速三个要素，分别给出酷热指数（Rothfus: The apparent temperature calculator combines the three factors of air temperature, relative humidity and wind speed to give the heat index (Rothfusz regression), the wind chill index (TWC/NWS) and the apparent temperature (Steadman AT), automatically selecting the primary reference value by temperature range. Runs purely on the front end; data is not uploaded.
map.三套国际通用公式同时计算: Three internationally common formulas computed at once
map.支持 m/s 与 km/h 两种风速单位: Supports both m/s and km/h wind speed units
map.按温度区间智能选取主参考值: Intelligently select the primary reference value by temperature range
map.实时显示体感风险等级: Show the apparent-temperature risk level in real time
map.夏季高温作业安全评估: Safety assessment for high-temperature summer work
map.冬季户外活动保暖参考: Warmth reference for winter outdoor activities
